Context: Children Education Allowance :-

| Component | Rate |
| ------------------------------ | -------------- |
| Children Education Allowance | ~ 2,250 p.m. |
| Hostel subsidy | t 6,750 p.m. |  
Whenever DA increases by 50%, CEA and Hostel subsidy shall increase by 25%. - Orders 1 and 2.  
- (h) Both hostel subsidy and Children Education Allowance can be availed concurrently.
- (i) Day-boarding children are not eligible to draw hostel subsidy.
